did: I did the first reach, for the two kinds of note on an episode. I compared seven tools and families for a note pinned to a moment of a video: YouTube comments, Clapshot, FreeFrame and its kin, Kitsu, Frame.io, Obsidian plugins and a Video.js timeline plugin. I recommended building, since none keeps the two kinds apart, takes a spoken part, or works from the phone with the notes on home. The owner agreed, and that is recorded as call C772. Then I wrote the rule into CLAUDE.md: before a story builds machinery of its own, look for an existing tool first, and record what you found as a call where building is one option among the tools. I added the owner's rule that policy limits like an essay's length move with the story. Review raises a missing reach as a question, not a block.

calls.title: When a reach is owed (C770)
options: Before the first PR of new machinery: a new record store, an editor, player or annotation layer, a sync path, a new service
calls.why: It catches the stories where a tool could replace real work, and leaves changes to existing screens alone.
calls.undo: Edit the list under 'When a reach is owed' in CLAUDE.md.

left: The #3035 design itself, a kind on each note and the scene-by-scene page, is not started. The reach only decided to build it.
